jobs.description:
About This Vacancy

Als Fullstack Software Engineer werk je aan de volledige keten van softwareontwikkeling: van gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces tot robuuste backendlogica en cloudintegraties. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende technologieën en werkt samen met collega’s en klanten aan innovatieve oplossingen die impact maken. Denk aan:

Ontwerpen en bouwen van webapplicaties met moderne front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare backendservices in bijvoorbeeld Java, C#, Node.js of Python.
Integreren van databases, APIs en cloudservices (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Waarborgen van kwaliteit en performance via CI/CD, testautomatisering en DevOps-principes.
Samenwerken met UX-designers, data-engineers en domeinexperts om complete oplossingen te realiseren.

What We Expect From You

3 tot 8 jaar ervaring met fullstack softwareontwikkeling in hightech of enterprise-omgevingen.
Aantoonbare ervaring met zowel front-end (React, Angular of Vue) als back-end (Java, C#, Node.js, Python).
Een afgeronde Bachelor-, bij voorkeur Masteropleiding in een technisch vakgebied (bijvoorbeeld informatica, software engineering of wiskunde).
Kennis van en ervaring met softwaredesign en ontwikkelprincipes (OOP, TDD, SOLID, Clean Code).
Ervaring met cloudplatforms (Azure, AWS of GCP) en containertechnologie (Docker, Kubernetes) is een plus.
Ervaring met Scrum, Agile of SAFe methodieken.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Een analytische, pragmatische en gestructureerde manier van werken.

What You Can Expect From Us

Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd, zodat je stabiliteit hebt in een dynamische omgeving.
Een uitgebreide individuele winstdeling.
Een individueel opleidingsbudget van €2.200 per jaar, zodat je jezelf continu kunt blijven ontwikkelen.
De kans om samen te groeien met onze ervaren professionals in onze kleinschalige, hechte business-cel.
Toegang tot ons TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, waar je je eigen ideeën en projecten tot leven kunt brengen.
Een omgeving waar jouw stem telt en waar jouw dromen werkelijkheid kunnen worden.

Bij TMC werk je in een uniek model waarin ondernemerschap, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en technologische innovatie samenkomen. Jij bepaalt de koers, wij zorgen voor de support en de mogelijkheden.

About Us:

At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We're the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Leadership/Team Quote:

"In Customer Service Software Engineering Services (CS SES), our focus is on empowering customer service agents with seamless Pega workflows so they can deliver world-class experiences to our travelers. As a Test Engineer on our team, you won't just execute tests—you will champion quality engineering, drive AI-driven testing innovation, and directly shape tools used by thousands of agents every day."

Role Description:

We are looking for a proactive Test Engineer II
to join our CS SES testing team in Amsterdam. In this role, you will work across cross-functional squads to test Pega workflows from an end-user perspective, with Customer Service agents as your primary focus. You will embed directly into Agile teams to drive risk-based testing, advocate for early testability, and build deterministic automated checks. If you are passionate about combining strong backend/API testing with low-code front-end applications and cutting-edge AI testing methodologies, this role offers an exciting opportunity to make a real impact on our operations.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

Independently execute test design, risk-based testing, and quality practices from initial design to release within cross-functional Agile squads.
Guide teams to make features testable early, advocating for isolated verification, shift-left testing, and sustainable root cause analysis.
Build and maintain deterministic, fast-feedback test automation for APIs and backend services using tools like Rest Assured, Playwright, or Postman.
Test and validate end-to-end Pega customer service workflows from an agent perspective while integrating non-functional checks (performance, accessibility, security, or resiliency).
Explore, implement, and test AI features and LLM models within testing workflows (e.g., using Claude Code or similar frameworks).
Coach and mentor less experienced test engineers on testing best practices, testability, and continuous quality improvements.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional squads and partner teams to communicate quality trade-offs clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Qualifications & Skills:

Strong experience in test design, execution, and test automation across the full software delivery lifecycle in Agile environments.
Proven hands-on experience in backend and API testing alongside front-end testing for low-code platforms,
Practical experience with relevant test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Rest Assured, Postman).
Demonstrated understanding of testing AI/LLM models and practical experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to enhance testing practices.
Solid understanding of risk-based testing, exploratory testing, non-functional testing, and observability/troubleshooting techniques.
Strong coaching, communication, and stakeholder management skills with a dedicated customer and end-user mindset.
Familiarity with Pega product architecture and workflows would be good to have.

Booking.com's Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave.
Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country).
Industry leading product discounts - up to €1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit.

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: "At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn't just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It's a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech."

Desarrollar nuevas aplicaciones, funcionalidades y automatizaciones internas.
Participar en el desarrollo y evolución de varios proyectos internos.
Crear integraciones entre diferentes aplicaciones, sistemas y bases de datos.
Identificar, junto al equipo, oportunidades para automatizar procesos actualmente manuales.

Realizar testing, mantenimiento y evolución de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Participar en nuevos proyectos relacionados con automatización e Inteligencia Artificial.
Evolucionar progresivamente hacia una mayor participación en el análisis de necesidades y definición de soluciones.

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

Aproximadamente 2-3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
Buena base de programación y experiencia práctica desarrollando aplicaciones o soluciones.
Conocimientos de SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Familiaridad con APIs e integración entre sistemas.
Experiencia trabajando con control de versiones, idealmente Git.
Interés por la Inteligencia Artificial aplicada al desarrollo de software y por nuevas formas de programar apoyándose en asistentes de IA.
Capacidad para entender problemas y convertirlos progresivamente en soluciones técnicas.
Inglés técnico suficiente para trabajar con documentación.

. Experiencia con Java, C#, Python o JavaScript/TypeScript será bienvenida.

Buscamos una persona curiosa, resolutiva y con ganas de aprender y crecer, a la que le guste programar pero también entender para qué está desarrollando una solución.

• Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework.
• Proven experience in developing and maintaining cloud-based applications.
• Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
• Deep knowledge of RESTful API design and implementation.
• Experience with relational databases (preferably SQL Server) and ORMs (preferably Entity Framework).
• Familiarity with cloud development, with Azure experience being a plus.

What's On Offer
• Competitive salary

• Hybrid working conditions available.
